evidence.value: Parasites (pentastomes pulmonaires, nématodes gastriques, helminthes intestinaux)
evidence.quote: American alligators are commonly infected with parasites.

evidence.value: Dans une étude texane de 2016, 100 % des alligators étaient infectés, par au moins 20 espèces de parasites.
evidence.quote: In a 2016 Texas study, 100% of the specimens collected were infected with parasites, and by at least 20 different species of parasites, including lung pentastomids , gastric nematodes , and intestinal helminths .

evidence.value: Adénovirus
evidence.quote: Adenoviruses may cause fatal liver or digestive tract diseases in certain snakes (Gaboon vipers, ball pythons, boa constrictors, rosy boas, and rat snakes), lizards (Jackson's chameleons, savannah monitors, and bearded dragons), and crocodilians.

evidence.value: Sangsues
evidence.quote: Leeches have been found on the legs, head, neck, and in the mouth of a variety of turtles and crocodilians.

evidence.value: Quelques sangsues sont peu nocives, mais un grand nombre peut abîmer la peau et transmettre d'autres maladies.
evidence.quote: A few leeches may not be harmful, but many may cause skin damage and transmit other diseases.

evidence.value: Maladie osseuse métabolique (hyperparathyroïdie secondaire nutritionnelle)
evidence.quote: Secondary nutritional hyperparathyroidism is the most common bone disease seen in pet reptiles.

evidence.value: Touche en particulier les lézards insectivores/herbivores en croissance rapide
evidence.quote: Affected reptiles are generally rapidly growing plant- and insect-eating lizards, turtles, or tortoises.

evidence.value: Mauvais appétit, faiblesse, difficulté à marcher, mâchoire ou os des pattes gonflés ou déformés, fractures de la colonne ou des pattes.
evidence.quote: Signs include poor appetite, weakness, an inability to walk normally, swollen or distorted jaw or leg bones, fractures of the spine or legs

evidence.value: Causée par un mauvais rapport calcium/phosphore, un manque de vitamine D3 ou de mauvaises conditions (pas d'UVB, température mal contrôlée) : fournir une alimentation équilibrée, des UVB et une bonne température.
evidence.quote: It is caused by a poor diet with the wrong ratio of calcium to phosphorus and a lack of vitamin D 3 or poor husbandry (lack of ultraviolet B light, inadequate temperature control in the cage).

evidence.value: Dès les premiers signes : le diagnostic nécessite des radiographies et des analyses de sang chez le vétérinaire.
evidence.quote: Diagnosis requires x-rays to document generalized loss of bone from the skeleton and blood tests that show low levels of vitamin D and an imbalance of calcium and phosphorus.

evidence.value: Stomatite infectieuse (« mouth rot »)
evidence.quote: Infectious stomatitis, infection and inflammation of the tissue lining the mouth, is seen in snakes, lizards, and turtles.

evidence.value: Petites taches rouge violacé dans la bouche au début ; le tissu malade progresse le long des rangées de dents.
evidence.quote: Early signs include tiny, purplish red spots in the mouth.

evidence.value: Consulter rapidement : sans traitement, une infection respiratoire ou digestive peut apparaître.
evidence.quote: Respiratory or gastrointestinal infection may develop if stomatitis is not treated promptly.

evidence.value: suite des symptômes
evidence.quote: Diseased tissue develops along the rows of teeth as the condition worsens.

evidence.value: Parasites intestinaux et vers de l'estomac
evidence.quote: Roundworms of the stomach ( stomach worms ) are seen in lizards and can cause stomach ulcers in severe infestations.

evidence.value: Ulcères de l'estomac en cas d'infestation importante.
evidence.quote: Roundworms of the stomach ( stomach worms ) are seen in lizards and can cause stomach ulcers in severe infestations.

evidence.value: Nettoyer régulièrement l'enclos, fournir de l'eau fraîche et retirer la nourriture non consommée.
evidence.quote: Good sanitation practices, such as cleaning the enclosure regularly, providing fresh water, and removing uneaten food, can help prevent infection and parasite infestation.

evidence.value: Le vétérinaire peut analyser les selles pour rechercher des parasites gastro-intestinaux.
evidence.quote: Your veterinarian can test your reptile's feces for gastrointestinal parasites.

evidence.quote: Since green basilisks prefer to spend their time either in the trees or in the water, at bare minimum you will need a large, sturdy branch for them to bask on, foliage to hide in, and a sufficiently large pool for swimming.
